gbm_population_evidence.quote: Confirmed histologic diagnosis of WHO Grade IV, Glioblastoma Multiforme

candidate_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab 400mg administered intravenously on Day 1, and then beginning 6 weeks post-surgery, subjects will receive 400 mg pembrolizumab every 6 weeks

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: GBM recurrence or progression with planned standard of care surgical resection and repeat radiation

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess the T cell clonality, CD8 T cell activation and Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocyte (TIL) score after treatment.

role_evidence.quote: assess the safety/tolerability/feasibility of pembrolizumab and radiation therapy before surgical resection in patients with recurrent glioblastoma
Standard of care stereotactic radiation of 24 grays over 3 days, administered beginning on Day 7

arms: Pembrolizumab with stereotactic radiation therapy and surgical resection

coder_notes: Pembrolizumab is the only investigational agent; stereotactic radiation and resection are described as standard of care and are not agents. Immune read-outs (T-cell clonality, CD8 activation, TIL score) coded as target engagement but not listed as molecular biomarkers.
